column1: # Strategy: the *provisioning* firmware lives in `factory` permanently.

# bootloader prefers OTA but falls back to factory whenever the active
# us the recovery-app pattern: any failure boots us back into
#   nvs       24 KiB   wifi creds + scadable_certs + libscadable state
#   phy_init  4 KiB    radio calibration data (IDF default location)
#   factory   1.5 MiB  this provisioning firmware (lots of headroom)
#   ota_0     1.5 MiB  customer firmware slot A
#   ota_1     1.5 MiB  customer firmware slot B
# Total: 4.5 MiB. Targets a 4 MiB chip if you swap factory→1.0 MiB; we
# default to 8 MiB so customer firmwares aren't forced into a tight
